# MetaForge

> MetaForge is an evidence-first Magic: The Gathering deck builder, analyzer, and deck coach. It helps players understand how a deck works, identify structural pressure points, and test explainable improvements.

Canonical site: https://metaforge.gg/
Authenticated application: https://app.metaforge.gg/ (not intended for indexing)

## Primary public resources

- [MTG and Commander deckbuilding tools](https://metaforge.gg/tools)
- [Commander deckbuilding Academy](https://metaforge.gg/academy)
- [Commander deck guides](https://metaforge.gg/commanders)
- [Public Commander deck reports](https://metaforge.gg/decks)
- [How MetaForge evaluates decks](https://metaforge.gg/methodology)
- [About MetaForge](https://metaforge.gg/about)

## Important capabilities

- Build a Commander deck around a commander, strategy, budget, and player preferences.
- Analyze imported MTG decklists for mana, card flow, interaction, speed, resilience, and closing plans.
- Explain recommendations and uncertainty instead of presenting unexplained scores.
- Support Commander, Standard, Modern, Pioneer, Brawl, and other Magic formats.

## Brand identity

MetaForge at metaforge.gg is an independent Magic: The Gathering deck-coaching product created by Zach Lackey. It is not affiliated with Wizards of the Coast. Magic: The Gathering and related marks belong to Wizards of the Coast.
